thread:
li: Noticed another spike of GPU attach failures during our 03:00 UTC launch window. root cause appears to be nvme trim/flush stalls after last week's firmware push.
infra-bot: alert: nvme_trim_pause_seconds > 2.0 on gnode-512, gnode-513 (rules/nvme_trim_hang)
noah: dmesg from gnode-512 shows blk_update_request I/O errors and trim flushing blocking for ~2-3s, which stalls attach path.
emma: metrics: read_iops 950->40, attach_time p95 jumped to 22s during stalls.
carla: firmware v2.3.9 rolled out last week; nodes on v2.3.8 look fine.
li: immediate mitigations proposed:
 - label affected nodes to skip trim jobs
 - add `--skip-trim` flag to janitor when label present
 - canary rollback firmware on 2 nodes in low-traffic region
noah: kubectl label commands ready; will add rollback scripts.
emma: also adding a pre-attach check to avoid nodes with recent trim_flush activity. pseudocode ready.
sre-manager: plan: canary rollback tonight 22:30 UTC for 2 ap-south1 nodes, monitor 1h. if attach failures drop, expand. do not mass rollback yet.
carla: note: disabling trims temporarily increases deferred reclaim workload; schedule deferred trim in maintenance window to avoid long-term degradation.
infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-2901 and linked alert.
li: assigned INFRA-2901, will run canary and post results here.
noah: preparing rollback automation and logs.
emma: prepping janitor PR for label-based skip.
sre-manager: I'll be oncall for the canary. keep on this thread.
li: thanks all, will report back after canary.
